* This inner class extends the X509CertSelector to add an additional
     * check to make sure the subject public key isn't on a particular list.
     * This class is used by buildToNewKey() to make sure the builder doesn't
     * end up with a CertPath to a public key that has already been rejected.

methods.name: public boolean match(Certificate cert)
methods.comment: * Decides whether a Certificate should be selected. * * @param cert the Certificate to be checked * @return true if the Certificate should be * selected, false otherwise

methods.name: public String toString()
methods.comment: * Return a printable representation of the CertSelector. * * @return a String describing the contents of the * CertSelector
